releaseNotes:
1. Inventory Accounting & FEFO: Unified inventory logic across Billing, Catalogue Edit, GRN Replenishment, and Spoilage/Wastage.
2. Multi-Store Isolation: Strict store_id segregation on product batches and inventory ledger.
3. Automatic Audit Ledger: Every stock change records immutable inventory ledger entries (GOODS_RECEIPT, SALE, DAMAGE_WASTAGE, ADJUSTMENT).
4. Accurate Stock Synchronization: Eliminated ghost stock fallbacks, ensuring 100% data integrity between Local POS and Cloud.
